## Recovered observations

109 points (from F2-54) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-s2-b4`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

Panel 1: The figure prints no time origin: time is counted from the timing line that carries the three deceleration rulers (0 ms), so only differences of time are measured; the timing lines are 10 ms apart (the figure's 0.01 s bar). Deceleration is in g as printed (G's), positive upward, converted with standard gravity; 0 g is each ruler's printed zero, not the dashed line drawn about 0.7 to 1.0 g above it. Samples are in drawing order and may share a time on a steep flank.
